property_summary: After any call to Collect, the recipient must receive exactly the requested amount _am, so the contract's remaining Ether balance equals its pre-call balance minus _am; the mutant instead sends the caller's entire remaining balance after subtraction, making the contract's balance drop by more than _am.
change_summary: Collect sends the caller's entire balance instead of the requested amount, changing the recipient value while still subtracting _am from state.
